headlines.title: US inflation heats up in September; Fed rate hike this month back on table - Reuters
headlines.summary: September CPI came in hot at 3.7% — energy from the Iran war is doing the Fed's dirty work in reverse, and now a rate hike this month is back on the table. That's a gut-punch to the long bond, rate-sensitive equities, and anything that's been riding the 'Fed pivot' trade. Every sector feels this one; it's the tape-changer of the day.

headlines.title: Two ships sink near Hormuz after being hit by projectiles amid surge in attacks - Reuters
headlines.summary: Ships sinking in the Strait of Hormuz is not a drill — roughly 20% of global oil flows through that chokepoint, and projectile attacks escalating to actual sinkings is a whole new level of ugly. Oil shipping costs are already spiking per other headlines, and this feeds directly into energy prices, inflation, and the Fed's impossible position. Energy stocks catch a bid; everything else gets nervous.

headlines.title: CoreWeave's AI bonds tumble, raising red flags for the wider market
headlines.summary: CoreWeave bonds trading at 81 cents on the dollar with yields blowing out past 15% is the credit market sending a flare up over the AI infrastructure borrowing binge — and credit leads equity, always. This isn't just a CoreWeave story; it's a warning shot for the whole AI capex trade, hitting Nvidia, data center REITs, and any name that's been priced for perfection on the AI buildout. When the bond market starts screaming, you listen.
